reason: I paid a consultant once for slides and got nothing, so the only reason I'd go ahead is that I pay nothing up front and only pay for meetings that happen. I'd take the free 15-company list first, and only start the pilot in relationship mode if those companies are ones I don't already know from the fairs.
objection: 45 meetings in 2 months sounds like mass email to me, and I don't believe the meetings will be real buyers with real freight. I'm also worried I'll spend my days arguing about which meetings count as qualified. At EUR 350 a meeting, a junior SDR with Apollo could cost me the same for a month.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies were ones I already know or obviously wrong for my lanes, I would walk away. To hold me past the pilot: talking directly to that logistics client about how many of the 45 meetings turned into actual quotes or contracts.
